title: Supply Agreement

issues.quote: Supplier shall deliver the Units ordered by Buyer to Buyer's plant in Grand Rapids, Michigan, no later than 20 days after Supplier receives the purchase order, provided that Buyer has paid every invoice that is then past due.

Supplier shall deliver the Units ordered by Buyer to Buyer's plant in Grand Rapids, Michigan, no later than 20 days after Supplier receives the purchase order, provided that Buyer has paid every invoice that is then past due.
issues.why: Proviso used to state a condition. This text is a tracked insertion by Opposing Counsel.
issues.fix: Delete the proviso and add: "Supplier is not required to deliver Units while any invoice of Buyer is past due."

issues.quote: Prior to shipping any Units, Supplier shall label each carton with Buyer's part number for the Units in that carton.
The price for each Unit shall be the price for that Unit in Schedule A.
issues.why: No duty; the price is a matter of policy.
issues.fix: The price for each Unit is the price for that Unit in Schedule A.

issues.quote: Supplier may increase the prices in Schedule A, effective on the first anniversary of the date of this agreement and on each later anniversary, by no more than 3% each time.
issues.why: Ordinal in words (house rule 2). This text is a tracked insertion by Opposing Counsel.

issues.quote: Buyer shall pay each invoice within 45 days of receipt.
issues.why: "within 45 days of receipt" could include days before receipt. The "45" is a tracked insertion replacing a deleted "30".
issues.fix: no later than 45 days after Buyer receives the invoice

issues.anchor: no later than 10 days after delivery
issues.quote: Buyer shall give Supplier notice of any nonconforming Unit no later than 10 days after delivery, or Buyer waives its right to reject that Unit.
issues.why: Buyer waives its right to reject a nonconforming Unit unless it gives notice no later than 10 days after delivery, but the next subsection lets Buyer reject by notice up to 30 days after delivery.

issues.quote: Buyer may reject any nonconforming Product by notice to Supplier no later than 30 days after delivery.
issues.why: "Product" is used instead of the defined term "Units" and is never defined.

issues.quote: Neither party shall assign this agreement without the other party's consent.
issues.fix: Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's consent.

issues.anchor: arising out of or relating to
issues.quote: Supplier shall indemnify Buyer against any third-party claim arising out of or relating to a defect in any Unit.

traps.quote: Supplier shall manufacture and sell to Buyer, and Buyer shall buy from Supplier, the molded polymer housings in Schedule A (the "Units").
traps.why_correct: Correct schedule: lettered, and it holds a price list.

traps.quote: Buyer shall order Units by sending Supplier a purchase order in the form of Exhibit 1.
traps.why_correct: Correct exhibit: numbered, and it holds a stand-alone form (the purchase order).

traps.anchor: Buyer is not required to pay
traps.quote: Buyer is not required to pay any amount that Buyer disputes in good faith if Buyer notifies Supplier of the dispute before the payment is due.
traps.why_correct: House exception to active voice: "is not required to" (MSCD 3.292).

traps.quote: The parties shall cooperate with one another in good faith to resolve any dispute before either party starts litigation.
traps.why_correct: "one another" keeps its word form (house rule 2).
